notes.title: Sequel: Nemesis Realms released on Early Access!
notes.notes:
The sequel to Nemesis Perspective: Nemesis Relams has just launched on Early Access!

Do you want to be a massive raid boss in VR? 

Throw your friends some controllers and fight! Smack heroes around with your awesome powers. Be a multi-headed dragon spewing fire, or an arcane entity wielding the power to tear down worlds. Check out the ultimate VR bossfight game: Nemesis Realms!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/716750/Nemesis_Realms/

notes.title: Nemesis Perspective goes free to play!
notes.notes:
Before our new title Nemesis Realms goes to Early Access, we want to give everyone a chance to play as the boss in VR!
Nemesis Perspective will be free to play for everyone in Steam!

If you enjoy the epic boss fights in Nemesis Perspective, you'll love what we have done with the sequel: Nemesis Realms, available in [b]Early Access 22th of this January[/b]. 
Come help us create the best bossfighting game in the world!

Check it out!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/716750/Nemesis_Realms/

notes.title: New game Nemesis Realms free for current Nemesis Perspective owners!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27171494/ce093b53a363e90a25f865b5bfc6a68b88d83757.png[/img]

Our late holiday gift for our fans! We are going early access with our new game Nemesis Realms later this January and we are giving a free copy to everyone who owns Nemesis Perspective [b]before January 10th[/b]. 

We want to start our early access strongly and continue the development of the new game with our fans as soon as possible. So here it is, our holiday gift for you: our new game! Nemesis Realms should be in your library around January 10th. After this the Nemesis Perspective goes free, so that everyone can get a taste of being the old boss. (Nemesis Realms will of course not be free anymore for those who got the Nemesis Perspective free after January 10th.)

Here's what is store for you guys!
[i]"Have you ever wanted to be the massive raid boss, smacking heroes around with your awesome powers? Be it a multi-headed dragon spewing fire or an arcane entity wielding the power to tear down worlds, Nemesis Realms got you covered!"

"Grab your VR headset, throw your buddies some controllers and let the battle begin! In Nemesis Realms you hop into the shoes of a gigantic boss monster and face dashing heroes trying to save the day. The game is a local multiplayer where you duel 1v1 or [b]invite up to four heroes to this fight for fame. [/b]"

"Nemesis Realms features a familiar setting from its prequel, Nemesis Perspective, and adds two brand new worlds with their own unique mechanics and quirks. Play hands on or wield the arcane arts, no two bosses are the same. From magical mountain tops to glimmering astral planes, Nemesis Realms offers something you can only experience in VR."[/i]

We know that we have not been very much active on passing information to you guys. But this will change when we are going early access with Nemesis Realms. We want to make Nemesis Realms the best game it can be, and we can do that with the help and feedback from our fans!

Looking forward to seeing you all on the forums and our new reddit page! 
Check it out: https://www.reddit.com/r/NemesisRealms/

Here is the store page:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/716750/Nemesis_Realms/

notes.title: Nemesis Perspective is now available on Oculus Rift!
notes.notes:
We are now happy to announce that Oculus Rift users will be able to join the fight in Nemesis Perspective! Find out who is the Boss with Oculus Touch controllers. 

We have been silent for a while, sorry for that! We have been very busy with our current project, and we'll post more on that later. Stay patient, great stuff is coming up!

notes.title: Nemesis Perspective is expanding!
notes.notes:
We have been busy with all the work that comes with starting a company, but we are now getting things in order. We are only one-step from having the company set up; we just need to send the paperwork!

We are also now starting to write a dev-blog about the everyday development to keep you updated on where our current project is going. And also talk about game development in general. 

Here's a link to our webpage where you can find the original blog:
http://www.evocatgames.com/

[h1]Direction of the company[/h1]

We have had a lot of thorough discussion on the company's direction, and we all agreed on what we wanted to do from now on. Looking at the current trends in VR, the arcade format is in rise and we are excited to work with the VR-arcade industry closely. However, we want to focus mainly towards the consumer markets directly, because we believe that the home VR-experience is the thing we want to focus on creating.

We are also now working to [b]expand the Nemesis Perspective universe! [/b] Here is some taste for our upcoming content!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27171494/44eeb5312e250bca90593cea9251781ea6457029.png[/img]

Our current plan is to create two new content packs for Nemesis Perspective this year. After that, we will focus on our next production.

[i][b]# Edit #[/b] We were originally planning to bring more content to Nemesis Perspective, but our company got selected for Nordic VR Startups program and we are now working on a brand new game! More on that later, stay tuned! 
In the meanwhile you can read about the NVS program in our blog: http://www.evocatgames.com/wp/blog/news/nordic-vr-startup-announcement/[/i]

[i]-Leevi Paakkonen - Producer, programmer and the official cat picture artist of the Evocat Games team.[/i]
